topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Oh no, you can't be serious about this, can you? A fence? Right between us? We've been neighbors for how long now, and it's always been open, always felt like an extension of our own space. I know people put up fences for privacy and all, but can we talk this through? Really talk? Maybe there's another way. A hedge, maybe, or some kind of boundary that’s not so...permanent. Please, let’s find a way to keep things the way they are. We’ve built so much together, haven’t we? This feels like it’s going to change everything, and I don’t want that. Please, let’s meet halfway on this.
